name: save-boot-16-mds7st1-reach-up
description: #168 fresh budget, attempt 3 (diagnostic; nothing here can time out after the load). Boot harness/saves/disc1-mds7st1.json (field 144) and load. Hold up for 300 frames (the walk ends against whatever is in the way, facing that way), press Circle (4 frames) and wait 30 frames. w0..w3: the state of each of the four message windows at the end (not 0 = that Circle talk opened a message in that window; attempt 2 watched window 0 only). n4, n5, n6: the talk-distance sign of each model attempt 2 found talkable (TalkOff 0) from the player at the end (-1 within TalkRange + the player's SolidRange). Only the states, the signs and load_done leave.
